name: Potion of Healing
description: A stoppered vial of red liquid that is faintly warm to the touch. Restores 2d4+2 hit points.

name: Flask of Holy Water
description: A small flask sealed with grey wax and stamped with the Ashen Order's sigil. Thrown at a foe in combat, it bursts for 2d4 radiant damage. The restless dead burn in it.

name: Vial of Memory-Tallow
description: Distilled from the luminous spore-wax that gathers in the Under-Barrow. Drinking it steadies the mind and restores 2 mana and 1d4+1 hit points.

name: Censer of Grave-Salt
description: A clay pot packed with coarse grey salt and iron filings used by tomb-auditors to shatter calcified shells. Thrown in combat, it bursts for 2d6 force damage.
